<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 600" width="600" height="600">

      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#1a1f4e;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0d1a3a;stop-opacity:1" />

    <linearGradient id="faceGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">

      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#c9c6dd;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#9f9cc6;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="nodeGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4cc9f0;stop-opacity:0.95" />

    <linearGradient id="textGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#7b2cbf;stop-opacity:0.9" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4cc9f0;stop-opacity:0.9" />
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="600" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/>
  <!-- Subtle grid pattern -->
  <g stroke="#2a3050" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.4">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="600" y2="0"/>

    <text x="300" y="370" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="12" opacity="0.8">you</text>

    <text x="430" y="460" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="12" opacity="0.8">deeply</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Central face/portrait shape -->
  <path d="M 300 200 C 250 180, 230 210, 245 240 C 235 280, 255 320, 275 350 C 270 380, 290 395, 305 395 C 320 395, 340 380, 335 350 C 355 320, 375 280, 365 240 C 380 210, 360 180, 310 200 Z"

  <!-- Face details -->

    <path d="M 320 225 V 240 H 300 V 225"/>
    <path d="M 300 250 H 285 V 310 H 315 V 250"/>
    <path d="M 310 260 V 250 H 300 V 260"/>

  <g opacity="0.6" stroke="#7b2cbf" stroke-width="1">
    <path d="M 285 230 V 245 H 300 V 230"/>
    <path d="M 300 245 H 315 V 230 H 300"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Floating question mark -->
  <text x="170" y="320" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="48" fill="#e8e6f0" opacity="0.3">?</text>
  <text x="440" y="380" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="48" fill="#e8e6f0" opacity="0.3">?</text>

  <!-- Floating exclamation mark -->
  <text x="300" y="500" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="48" fill="#e8e6f0" opacity="0.3">!</text>

  <!-- Circuit lines emanating from head -->
  <g stroke="#4cc9f0" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7">
    <path d="M 310 200 C 350 180 380 190 410 220"/>
    <path d="M 290 200 C 250 180 220 190 190 220"/>
    <path d="M 300 200 C 300 150 310 130 300 110"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#7b2cbf" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7">
    <path d="M 310 400 C 350 420 380 410 410 390"/>
    <path d="M 290 400 C 250 420 220 410 190 390"/>
  </g>
</svg>
